answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network funnels identity verification through a cryptographic attestation chain. Each identity claims admission via an unforgeable zero-knowledge proof of staked collateral. Much like navigating an icy tundra or entering a narrow inlet, every clustered node must pass progressive staking curves. Sybil swarms face exponential capital exhaustion, making fake scale an unviable fable as costs scale quadratically per peer.
